Document represents a complete picture of priority areas for international climate collaboration. S6.5 on long-horizon resilience research (space-based agriculture, closed-loop life support, planetary engineering models) would be value-add but not essential; omitted due to document length considerations and preference for completing a coherent plan within the grant period rather than rushing additional sections. Core message—that terrestrial and oceanic photosynthesis capacity is the foundation of climate resilience and should be the organizing principle of international action—has been established across all seven sections. The long-term framing favors actions with compounding effects on planetary productivity over centuries.
